job_post_detail.title: Content Video Editor-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
1、Learn and explore the creative possibilities of 360 footage and immersive video formats.
2、Edit short-form videos for social media, campaigns, product storytelling, tutorials, and brand content.
3、Bring fresh ideas on how to use 360 footage to create stronger stories, transitions, angles, and perspectives.
4、Support the team in editing drone footage, lifestyle footage, product clips, and event content.
5、Create dynamic edits for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and e-commerce channels.
6、Work with the Creative Director and video team to develop new editing styles for Antigravity content.
7、Explore new storytelling methods, including reframing 360 footage, POV storytelling, fast transitions, split-screen, motion tracking, and immersive camera movement.
8、Support music selection, pacing, rough cuts, final edits, subtitles, basic color correction, and export versions for different platforms.
9、Collaborate with designers, motion designers, 3D artists, and retouchers to integrate graphics, titles, UI elements, and product highlights into video content.
10、Research new video trends across social media, travel, sports, gaming, technology, outdoor lifestyle, and creator culture.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Experience editing 360 footage, drone footage, FPV footage, sports footage, or action camera content.
2、Basic knowledge of reframing 360 videos and creating different camera paths from one 360 clip is a plus.
3、Basic color grading, sound design, motion graphics, or subtitle design skills are a plus.
4、Experience with Insta360 Studio, Premiere plugins, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve is a plus.
5、Interest in AI video tools such as Runway, Kling, Pika, Luma, or similar tools is a plus.
6、Ability to create edits with strong hooks, good pacing, and platform-native storytelling.
